field_checks.summary: Source XML/PDF/supplement surfaces were inspected and final activity/toxicity rows are row-level, but all 24 activity rows and all 9 toxicity rows omit an explicit exact-vs-approximate field/status. Figure-derived and graph-only/nonconvertible values therefore do not satisfy the requested field-level normalization contract.

All 12 DBAASP fallback machine candidates remain unresolved_record with no source_verified promotion; linked authoritative DBAASP/merged rows are absent and authoritative_dbaasp_ingest_ready is false. This is acceptable only as cautioned paper-level evidence, not authoritative database ingest.

Common paper-final and packet-final JSON files are byte-identical, and counts agree with review_report. However, current final materials_manifest.json still says analysis_queue_status=analysis_queued and strict_boundary='packet handoff only', while packet_manifest, analysis_status, and strict acceptance report say analysis_source_reviewed_accepted/open tickets 0. The final review report also retains runtime_open_ticket_ids for three now-closed tickets, so final status metadata is not current.

Mechanism claims preserve ontology boundaries: SEM and NPN are the only direct_mechanism claims; MIC/growth is phenotype_supported; zeta/self-assembly/CPFx-DNA-gyrase discussion remains inferred; ROS was not retained as a mechanism claim.

Primary identity matches PMC12153049, DOI 10.1039/d5ra02932e, PMID 40503297, title, and one staged supplement. The four source entities 1, 2, CPFx-1, and CPFx-2 are linked to source construction/synthesis surfaces; no plain one-letter sequence plus sequence_length object was present for residue-length mismatch checking.

Recursive source_locator scan over final mirrors found no artifact-path source locators, and numeric rows have units. Blocking issue remains that exact-vs-approximate status is missing from every final activity/toxicity record, including exact figure labels, exact Table S1 cells, graph-only toxicity surfaces, and qualitative in vivo surfaces.

Recursive authority and fallback release boundaries are scientifically preserved: fallback rows are not authoritative ingest-ready and recursive final source locators are clean. The check fails because final status/rework metadata is stale: final materials_manifest contradicts live accepted analysis state and final review_report preserves three runtime_open_ticket_ids although live open ticket count is zero.

Cautions are preserved rather than smoothed: no authoritative DBAASP rows, 12 unresolved fallback candidates, graph-only toxicity surfaces, and mechanism limitations. These cautions are not themselves blocking because fallback ingest remains false and mechanism boundaries are preserved.

The staged supplement PDF and extracted text/tables were inspected. Current supplementary_tables.json contains Table S1 plus five figure surfaces, but extraction_status.json still reports supplementary_table_count=0 even after updated_at 2026-07-27T17:00:06Z. That stale packet material count undermines deep-retrieval/material-exhaustion evidence.

Toxicity/selectivity surfaces are present for BEAS-2B viability, LDH release, hemolysis, body weight, and organ histology, but every toxicity record lacks explicit exact-vs-approximate status. Graph-only records are marked not_convertible, but the required exact/approx provenance field is omitted.
